svg.text: Base score 0-100, mean over 36 scenarios (G1-G8, 7 of them extreme); the diamond is the extreme-tier score. Scores compare only within suite v2.0.
hatched = a regular-tier PARTIAL/FAIL or an excluded scenario
Extreme = mean of the extreme scenarios (one per group, none for G6)
small numbers refer to the notes below
